# Side bucket catalog for time series updates and deletes — facts

> Source-anchored units about Side bucket catalog for time series updates and deletes: 9 across 3 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-24 · 9 units · 3 sources · rights: quote -->

## How it works

- [statement] When the stage is destroyed and has newly inserted bucket IDs, it finishes their direct-write tracking in the global catalog and merges the side catalog collection execution statistics into that catalog. Consequently, those statistics are not necessarily a separate reporting namespace. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/classic/timeseries_modify.cpp · keywords: Side bucket catalog for time series updates and deletes

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] For multi updates, the implementation guide describes spooling scanned bucket record IDs and inserting updated measurements into new buckets to avoid the Halloween problem; the spool can spill when its memory limit is reached. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/README.md · keywords: Side bucket catalog for time series updates and deletes

## Facts and statements

- [statement] In the inspected master implementation, TimeseriesModifyStage allocates a side BucketCatalog only for updates, with one stripe and getTimeseriesSideBucketCatalogMemoryUsageThresholdBytes as its threshold callback. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/classic/timeseries_modify.cpp · keywords: Side bucket catalog for time series updates and deletes · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/classic/timeseries_modify.h
- [statement] Measurement updates remove old values and insert changed measurements into new buckets; unchanged measurements remain in the original bucket, which is deleted if none remain. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/README.md · keywords: Side bucket catalog for time series updates and deletes · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/classic/timeseries_modify.cpp
- [statement] timeseriesSideBucketCatalogMemoryUsageThreshold controls idle-bucket expiry in the side catalog. The inspected MongoDB parameter definition and ApsaraDB 8.0 table specify a default of 104857600 bytes; the MongoDB definition permits startup and runtime changes. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/timeseries.idl · keywords: Side bucket catalog for time series updates and deletes · also: https://help.aliyun.com/en/mongodb/user-guide/parameters-available-in-mongodb-8-0
- [statement] Measurement deletes repack surviving measurements into the original bucket, or delete that bucket if none survive. A predicate covering a whole bucket can bypass unpacking. The delete helper receives no side catalog. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/README.md · keywords: Side bucket catalog for time series updates and deletes · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/classic/timeseries_modify.cpp
- [statement] ApsaraDB’s kernel-parameter release notes list the side-catalog memory threshold for MongoDB 8.0 in the July 2025 additions. This dates the managed-service exposure, not the upstream feature’s introduction. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-06-22) — https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/product-overview/engine-release-notes · keywords: Side bucket catalog for time series updates and deletes
- [statement] timeseriesSideBucketCatalogMemoryUsageThreshold defaults to 104857600 bytes (100 MiB). Upstream IDL and Alibaba MongoDB 8.0 documentation describe it as the memory threshold above which idle side-catalog buckets expire; they do not describe a strict total-memory ceiling. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/timeseries.idl · keywords: Side bucket catalog for time series updates and deletes · also: https://help.aliyun.com/en/mongodb/user-guide/parameters-available-in-mongodb-8-0
- [statement] Upstream IDL allows the side-catalog threshold to be set at startup or runtime. Alibaba lists its managed MongoDB 8.0 parameter with a 52428800–209715200-byte range and no restart requirement. That service range must not be assumed to be an upstream validator. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/timeseries.idl · keywords: Side bucket catalog for time series updates and deletes · also: https://help.aliyun.com/en/mongodb/user-guide/parameters-available-in-mongodb-8-0
